header: These are the components that RENDER. Each picture is a real ChatCut frame of that component, not a mock. Pick by what the moment needs. THEY ARE NOT RANKED and the order carries no meaning. USING ONE TWICE IS FINE when two moments do the same job. A component that is not on this sheet is not available.

entries.name: AnnotationArrow
entries.when: WHEN A REGION OF THE FRAME NEEDS POINTING AT
entries.claim: Look at THIS thing on screen.
entries.what: hand-drawn marker arrow (chevron head, jitter, default #C8551F) drawing on like a live pen, retracting on exit

entries.name: BarRace
entries.when: WHEN A NUMBER LANDS
entries.claim: Watch these values race — the biggest wins.
entries.what: a centered stack of 2–4 horizontal bars growing to lengths proportional to their values; each has a caps label and a value counting up at the bar's tip, and the highest flips to gold with a crown as it pulls ahead

entries.name: ChatThread
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: This is the literal exchange — both sides.
entries.what: full iMessage screen: header, stacked bubbles (outgoing #0A84FF right, incoming #26252A left), typing indicators resolving into messages, home indicator. ~820×1320px

entries.name: DropBanner
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: Here's the framework, one point at a time.
entries.what: a full-width banner that drops from the top with a bounce, opens on a numbered-circle intro (connected 1-2-3 rings), then scrolls through one captioned point per beat, each point's words lighting grey→black as if spoken
props: { "title": "The 3-Part Hook", "subtitle"?: "Why people keep watching", "count"?: 3, "points"?: [{"title": "1. The Missing Piece", "caption": "Tell them what they don't know yet."}], "accentColor"?: "#F5A11E" }

entries.name: DropCard
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: Here's the framework, on a clean card.
entries.what: the floating-card sibling of DropBanner: a rounded card inset from the edges drops in near the top with a numbered dashed stepper (a short label under each circle), then scrolls one captioned point per beat with words lighting grey→black
props: { "title": "Hook Framework", "titleLead"?: "3", "steps"?: [{"label": "Hook"}, {"label": "Tension"}, {"label": "Payoff"}], "points"?: [{"title": "1. The Missing Piece", "caption": "Tell them what they don't know yet."}], "accentColor"?: "#F5A11E" }

entries.name: EditorialQuote
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: Someone notable said this.
entries.what: a centered serif quote in italic Playfair behind a big opening quotation mark, with a tall accent left-bar and an optional author + role attribution that fades in beneath; lines reveal one at a time and the type auto-fits the frame
props: { "text": "Most growth happens outside your comfort zone", "author"?: "James Clear", "role"?: "Atomic Habits", "fontKey"?: "playfairDisplay"|"dmSerifDisplay", "showQuoteMark"?: true, "accentColor"?: "#FFD60A", "anchor"?: "upper_third_safe"|"center"|"lower_third_safe" }

entries.name: IMessageBubble
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: The EXACT text message — see the actual SMS.
entries.what: single iMessage bubble with iOS tail; incoming gray left / outgoing blue right; optional Delivered/Read status; optional typewriter reveal. ~600-800px wide

entries.name: InstagramComment
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: This IG comment exists — receipts.
entries.what: IG comment row: avatar, bold username, single-line comment, timestamp, heart + like count

entries.name: MouseDrag
entries.when: WHEN THE SCREEN OR APP IS THE SUBJECT
entries.claim: Watch this get dragged into place.
entries.what: a UI cursor drags a labeled card in from off-frame and drops it into place with a settle, then arcs back out as the card dissolves away

entries.name: Notification
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: This phone event actually happened — here's the banner.
entries.what: platform banner drops from the top with spring bounce; up to 3 stack, staggered ~400ms

entries.name: PillCluster
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: Here are the tags for this idea.
entries.what: a tidy cluster of rounded keyword pills that spring-pop in together as a staggered cascade, with every few pills accent-filled for rhythm

entries.name: PillMarquee
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: A living stream of tags for this topic.
entries.what: rows of rounded keyword pills scrolling horizontally across a soft band, alternating direction per row with edge fades, optionally each a different palette hue

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.when: WHEN A NUMBER LANDS
entries.claim: Here is the quantitative ARC — watch it advance.
entries.what: horizontal bar, gray track, white fill, optional gold eyebrow label (#D4A12A); fill expands 0 → target with the number counting up; milestone ticks light as crossed

entries.name: PullQuote
entries.when: WHEN SOMETHING IS NAMED OR REVEALED
entries.claim: What they just said, as the whole screen.
entries.what: the speaker's own line blown up full-frame in bold caps, building word-by-word with keywords landing bigger and in an accent color. No card, no quotation marks, no name
props: { "text": "Most people quit right before the breakthrough", "keywords"?: ["quit","breakthrough"], "highlightStyle"?: "color"|"bar"|"scale", "keywordColor"?: "#FFD60A", "fontKey"?: "anton", "anchor"?: "upper_third_safe"|"center"|"lower_third_safe" }

entries.name: RankedList
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: The ranked list, in order.
entries.what: a clean ordered Top-N: numbered badges + labels reveal top→bottom, each badge popping a beat before its label wipes in, a hairline rule under each row, #1 subtly highlighted

entries.name: RecordingFrame
entries.when: WHEN THE SCREEN OR APP IS THE SUBJECT
entries.claim: This is RAW — caught, unfiltered.
entries.what: thin red inset border (~6-8px, default #C5432E), optional live corner annotations (timestamp, word count, WPM), optional slow scan-line

entries.name: Reticle
entries.when: WHEN A REGION OF THE FRAME NEEDS POINTING AT
entries.claim: Lock onto THIS exact spot.
entries.what: HUD corner-brackets that snap onto a small rectangular region with an overshoot lock, a brief acquiring wobble, an inner scan sweep, and a monospace tag that slides in after lock

entries.name: SectionDivider
entries.when: WHEN TIME OR SEQUENCE IS THE STORY
entries.claim: A new section starts here.
entries.what: a full-frame chapter card: an eyebrow kicker and a giant index over an accent rule, with the big title unfolding line-by-line from behind the line; optional dark scrim

entries.name: Stamp
entries.when: WHEN A CLAIM GETS A VERDICT OR STAMP
entries.claim: Stamp it — this is OFFICIAL.
entries.what: a circular VERIFIED-style seal (or rectangular rubber-stamp) that slams onto the frame from oversized to rest with weight: a compression-recoil bounce, a locked tilt, a flash and an expanding shock ring, then a brief settle. Single-ink — ring and text share one color

entries.name: StatCard
entries.when: WHEN A NUMBER LANDS
entries.claim: The HEADLINE NUMBER the speaker just stated, full size.
entries.what: hero number (~120-180pt, white) counting up digit-by-digit from 0 (or fromValue) to target; accent divider drawing in; caps label below; optional prefix/suffix. No card background — the number floats over the footage

entries.name: StepDivider
entries.when: WHEN TIME OR SEQUENCE IS THE STORY
entries.claim: We're on step N of the process.
entries.what: a full-frame step card: a "STEP 2 / 05" kicker, a giant title, and a segmented progress bar filled to the current step

entries.name: StickyNotes
entries.when: WHEN STEPS OR ITEMS ARE ENUMERATED
entries.claim: Three parallel items worth pinning.
entries.what: same component as the sticky_note text overlay: three notes slamming into the upper third

entries.name: TikTokComment
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: This TikTok comment exists.
entries.what: TikTok comment row in TikTok's specific UI

entries.name: Timeline
entries.when: WHEN TIME OR SEQUENCE IS THE STORY
entries.claim: Here's the PROCESS, step by step.
entries.what: a vertical rail of numbered station-nodes with a label card beside each; an accent fill travels node→node and a comet head rides it, each station popping active as the fill docks

entries.name: TimelineRoadmap
entries.when: WHEN TIME OR SEQUENCE IS THE STORY
entries.claim: Here's the journey, stage by stage.
entries.what: a winding S-curve "road" of numbered stations with a comet that travels the path, each station popping active with its label + time sublabel as the comet docks (the scenic-route variant of Timeline)

entries.name: TweetBubble
entries.when: WHEN SOCIAL PROOF OR A MESSAGE IS QUOTED
entries.claim: This specific tweet exists.
entries.what: Twitter/X post card: avatar, name + handle, optional verified check, body, engagement stats ticking up on entrance
props: { "name": "Elon Musk", "handle": "@elonmusk", "text": "Tweet body content here.", "verified"?: bool, "stats"?: {"replies": int, "reposts": int, "likes": int, "views": int}, "darkMode"?: bool }
